conditions:
Where the legal guardian of any of the following persons (hereinafter referred to as "
Child
"):
(i) a child of eight years old or younger;
(ii) a person under adult guardianship; or
(iii) a person with a mental disorder defined in Article 2(2) 2 of the Act on Welfare of Persons with Disabilities, classified as a person with a severe disability defined in subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Act on the Employment Promotion and Vocational Rehabilitation of Persons with Disabilities (limited to those registered as disabled persons under Article 32 of the Act on Welfare of Persons with Disabilities);
gives consent to the use or provision of personal location information regarding the child

the legal guardian who intends to consent to the use or provision of personal location information of the child must submit a written consent to us at
dataprotection@wechat.com
along with a document proving that he/she is the legal guardian

references.text: Article 26(1) of the Location Information Act
Article 2(2) 2 of the Act on Welfare of Persons with Disabilities
subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Act on the Employment Promotion and Vocational Rehabilitation of Persons with Disabilities
Article 32 of the Act on Welfare of Persons with Disabilities
